summary: One church. Weekend, weekday and Saturday confession times agree in both image-only issues (Nov 8 and Nov 15), the intentions and the website; the newest adds dated Advent evenings (Dec 1/15 Adoration, Dec 8 7 PM Mass, Dec 22 penance). Open: whether the Divine Mercy Adoration Chapel (no address printed) is at the church, the holy-day box's Dec 7 vigil and Dec 8 12:05 Masses, and the Over 50 Club's Nov 17 memorial Mass.
